versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The Cross Cluster Communication on the client side of the Software Cluster Connection shall provide a request queue (with queue length 1) for each assigned Client Server Communication Graph , where the referenced ClientServerOperation is owned by a delegation RPort- Prototype at the CompositionSwComponentType of the rootSoftwareCompo- sition of the Ecu Extract . Note: The structure of the queue is implementation specific, but the Cross Cluster Communication has to store at least the IN parameters and IN/OUT parameters, the transaction handle and the status code of the communication.
